eligibility: All valid raw pairs retained in descriptives; sums within 1e-6, no normalization. Log fits require every p>0 in both orders. Fail on malformed input, retain failed artifacts.
estimator: One gamma[K] across all FIT producers: per K equal producer, equal broad group within producer, equal eligible rows within group, options 1/K. Center log(original)-log(reverse) per case then average mirror contrast (y[j]-y[K-1-j])/2. No epsilon, second model, alternate split, family fit, or outcome-driven revision.

field_roles.broad_group: domain for intent/sentiment; mechanism for rule_application; fallback source_group then explicit unknown
field_roles.positions: original_positions/reversed_positions, ONE-based slots of those same identities; exact reversal
field_roles.probabilities: original_p/reversed_p aligned to original option_ids, raw saved binary64 values

hash_scope: Exact bytes of script, primary predeclaration, supporting method and four permitted public files; no upstream files accessed.
manual_review: Full script read before binding; checked original-identity alignment, ONE-based reversal mapping, source split/nesting, hierarchical weights, centered mirror fit, bidirectional predictions, raw TV and zero handling. No outcome statistics inspected before freeze.
precedence: Primary predeclaration overrides method epsilon sensitivity, alternate split, or second learned model. No TRAIN diagnostic executed.
summaries: Per-K source/group-balanced heldout metrics; macro supported K equally. Per-source/K metrics rebalance groups within source. Case RMS quantiles are unweighted linear-interpolated descriptive quantiles. Probability descriptives unweighted rows within each displayed stratum; tied cases excluded from unique-argmax transitions. TV uses raw sums, only modeled softmax normalizes.
